none: PAS NLM-B68EFC: Early Medieval Coin: Northumbrian Styca of Aethelred II
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Northumbrian styca, possibly of Aethelred II (840-849). Obverse description; Plain cross with a pellet in each angle, pelleted border. Obverse inscription: +EDIL[---]RE. Reverse description: Central cross pattee in ring of pellets; pelleted border; initial cross pattee. Reverse inscription: LEO[--]?AN. Diameter: 12.67mm, Weight: 0.91gms, die axis: possibly 12
